about.text: A soft, white, salty Sudanese cheese pickled in brine or whey, resembling feta; made from cow, goat or sheep milk, usually at home or on small farms.

links.name: FAO, The technology of traditional milk products in developing countries, ch. 7

facts.v: Ed Dueim and El Obeid, in the seasonal milk surplus of nomad herds
Eaten across Sudan with breads and stews; in one source it is the most consumed cheese in Sudan by per-capita figures, ahead of muddaffara
